info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Product Inventory Distribution Review-spec
info.description: The Product Inventory Distribution Review API facilitates the submission of reviews for product inventory distribution within specific banking channels. This endpoint allows businesses to collect feedback on inventory distributions for better decision-making and product management. Users such as channel managers and inventory analysts can leverage this API to enhance product visibility and accuracy. Typical use cases include evaluating inventory performance and integrating customer insights into inventory strategies.
